blocks.text: Carbohydrates qudrati organic compounds hain, jin mein shakar, nishasta (starch) aur cellulose aur bacteria ki cell walls aur keeron ke bairooni dhaanchon ke maadde shamil hain. Yeh hamari khurak mein tawanai ka bara zariya hain. Kimiyai taur par yeh polyhydroxy aldehydes ya ketones, ya un se bane compounds hain; naam 'carbon ke hydrates' Cn(H2O)y jaise formulon se aaya hai.

Monosaccharides sab se saada carbohydrates, yani saada shakar jaise glucose aur fructose, hain; inhein mazeed saada shakar mein hydrolyse nahi kiya ja sakta. In ka aam formula Cn(H2O)n hai, jahan n teen se saat tak hai: triose mein teen carbon atoms, tetrose mein chaar, pentose mein paanch aur hexose mein chhe. Inhein functional group se bhi taqseem kiya jata hai: aldose mein aldehyde group aur ketose mein ketone group hota hai. Glucose aldose aur fructose ketose hai.

Monosaccharides khuli zanjeer ya halqe ki shakal mein hote hain; paanch carbon (pentoses) ya chhe carbon (hexoses) wali shakar halqe ki shakal mein zyada mustahkam aur zyada aam hain. Fructose paanch rukni halqa (furanose) aur glucose chhe rukni halqa (pyranose) banata hai. Khuli zanjeer aur halqe ki shakalein aik doosre mein badalti hain: glucose ke C5 ka OH C1 ke C=O se jur kar halqa band karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: D-glucose khuli zanjeer ki shakal mein, C1 par CHO, C2, C4 aur C5 par OH daen aur C3 par baen, aur C6 par CH2OH. Beech: glucose ka chhe rukni halqa, ring ka O, C5 par CH2OH halqe ke oopar aur C1 se C4 par OH groups, C1 ka OH neeche (alpha shakal). Daen: fructose khuli zanjeer ki shakal mein, C1 par CH2OH, C2 par C=O, phir HO-C-H aur do H-C-OH groups, aur CH2OH.
blocks.caption: Glucose ki khuli zanjeer aur halqe ki banawat, aur fructose (Figure 27.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Glucose aur fructose ka formula aik, C6H12O6, hai, lekin glucose ke C1 par aldehyde group aur fructose ke C2 par ketone group hai. Paani mein glucose zyada tar halqe ki shakal mein hota hai, jo C5 ke OH ke aldehyde group se jurne se banta hai; thori si miqdar khuli zanjeer ki shakal mein hoti hai.

blocks.text: Shakar ke molecules ke bohat se hydroxyl groups un ke darmiyan wasee hydrogen bonding dete hain, is liye khalis monosaccharides thos hain. Mehlool mein yeh paani ke saath wasee hydrogen bonds banate hain, jis se bohat ghulte hain. Monosaccharides fauri tawanai ka behtareen zariya hain: glucose ko blood sugar kehte hain kyunke yeh insani khoon mein hota hai, jab ke fructose phalon aur shehed mein wafir hai. (Shehed ka gaarha pan us ke fructose aur glucose ki mazboot hydrogen bonding se hai.)

Disaccharides do monosaccharide units par mushtamil hain jo glycosidic linkage se jure hon, aam formula C12H22O11; aam misalein sucrose, lactose aur maltose hain. Yeh condensation reaction se bante hain: aik monosaccharide ka hydroxyl group doosre ke hydroxyl group ke hydrogen se mil kar paani ka aik molecule chhorta hai. Banne wala C-O-C bond glycosidic bond hai. Sucrose, mez ki cheeni, glucose aur fructose ka disaccharide hai.

Polysaccharides bohat se monosaccharide units ke jurne se bane bare molecules hain, zyada molecular mass aur aam formula (C6H10O5)n ke saath. Hydrolysis par yeh monosaccharides dete hain. Aam misalein starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin hain.

items: Starch paudon ka asal tawanai ka zakheera hai aur glucose units se bana hai. Is ke do hisse hain: amylose, lambi baghair shaakh zanjeeron ke saath, aur amylopectin, aik gathi, bohat shaakh dar banawat. Aloo, chukandar, chawal aur anaaj mein starch zyada hota hai.

Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka asal dhaanchay ka maadda hai. Yeh glucose units (taqreeban 2500 tak) ki lambi baghair shaakh zanjeeron par mushtamil hai; zanjeerein aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, jis se cellulose sakht aur paani mein na ghulne wala hai. Insani khurak mein yeh resha (fibre) hai jo aanton ki sehat behtar karta hai.
Glycogen (haiwani starch) glucose ka polymer hai jo jaanwaron ke jigar aur muscles mein jama hota hai. Is ki banawat amylopectin jaisi lekin zyada shaakh dar hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: glucose ka hexagon aik O atom (C1-O-C2) ke zariye fructose ke pentagon se jura, mua'adla C6H12O6 + C6H12O6 -> C12H22O11 + H2O. Neeche: amylose glucose hexagons ki seedhi zanjeer (alpha-1,4 links); amylopectin shaakh wali zanjeer (alpha-1,6 shaakh ki jagah); cellulose do seedhi zanjeerein jo dashed hydrogen bonds se jureen (beta-1,4 links).
blocks.caption: Sucrose aur glucose ke teen polysaccharides (Figures 27.2 aur 27.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Glycosidic link shakar units ko aik oxygen atom ke zariye, paani kho kar, jorta hai. Starch aur glycogen alpha links use karte aur glucose ke gathe zakheere mein lipat'te ya shaakhein banate hain, jab ke cellulose beta links use karta jo zanjeeron ko seedha rakhte hain, is liye parosi zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se mazboot resha banati hain.

blocks.title: Do bayanaat ki jaanch
blocks.text: Kitab sucrose ko monosaccharide ki misal deti hai; sucrose disaccharide hai. Yeh bhi kehti hai ke shakar mehlool mein seedhi banawat mein hoti hai; darasal mehlool mein zyada tar molecules halqe hote hain, khuli zanjeer ki thori si shakal ke saath equilibrium mein.

blocks.prompt: Fructose ki khuli zanjeer CH2OH-CO-CH(OH)-CH(OH)-CH(OH)-CH2OH hai (C3 ka OH baen). (i) Yeh halqa kaise banata hai? (ii) Kya fructose paani mein ghulta hai? (iii) Khalis halat mein is ki tabeei halat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: (i) C5 ka OH C2 ke C=O se jurta aur oxygen atom wala paanch rukni halqa (furanose) banta hai. (ii) Haan: is ke bohat se -OH groups paani se hydrogen bonds banate hain. (iii) Thos, kyunke is ke -OH groups molecules ke darmiyan wasee hydrogen bonds banate hain.

blocks.prompt: Glycosidic linkage kya hai, aur glucose aur fructose ke darmiyan kaise banti hai?
blocks.explanation: Do shakar units ke darmiyan C-O-C link, jo condensation se banta hai: glucose ka -OH (C1 par) aur fructose ka -OH (C2 par) paani ka aik molecule khote hain, aur shakar aik oxygen atom se jur kar sucrose banti hai.

blocks.prompt: Carbohydrates ke do kaam bayan karein aur unhein un ki banawat se jorein.
blocks.explanation: Tawanai dena: glucose chhota aur ghulne wala hai, is liye khoon mein safar karta aur jaldi oxidise hota hai. Tawanai jama karna: starch aur glycogen bare, shaakh dar aur na ghulne wale hain, is liye paani ke tawazun par asar ke baghair bohat glucose gatha jama karte hain. (Dhaancha: cellulose ki seedhi, hydrogen bond wali zanjeerein mazboot resha banati hain.)

items: Monosaccharides (glucose: aldose; fructose: ketose); paani mein halqe.
Disaccharides (sucrose, lactose, maltose) glycosidic links se.
